_notes: UK life-story 'Where will you be born this time?' — Birmingham. Every spoken sentence contains 'bloody'. #swear# words are bleeped in the final mix and masked in captions.

Facts: ~1 in 200 of the world's births are in the UK (ONS/NRS/NISRA vs UN); ~15,000 births a year in Birmingham (ONS, approx.); more miles of canal than Venice (Canal & River Trust); Spaghetti Junction opened 1972; Cadbury in Birmingham since 1824, Cadbury World in Bournville; Peaky Blinders set in Birmingham; ~100 million cups of tea a day in the UK (UK Tea & Infusions Association); the balti is supposedly a Birmingham invention; 'cob' = bread roll; the Brummie accent keeps topping 'least attractive' polls; Black Sabbath formed in Birmingham in 1968; UK life expectancy ~80 (ONS); 'tara-a-bit' = goodbye.
